notes.title: New Update Test 0.20
notes.notes:
To access this version, right-click the game in your Steam library, select "Properties," go to the "Betas" tab, and choose "update_beta_0.20" from the dropdown menu.


 Reduced memory usage and size on disk. Performance improvments
 Fixed Collider Issues
 Traffic with working lights
 2 New vehicles
 Boxer Engine
 Phone works with keyboard now
 Partial Gamepad Support
 Logitech g29 support (no force feedback for now)
 Big used engines store
 You can wrap your car now in the wrap store
 Selling Cars fixed
 Popups when you are close to a house that you can buy.
 Popups when you are close to a barn that has a car for sale.
 Bigger Tuning Shop
 Used engine internals effect performance
 Forged pistons,headers, better radiators that effect performance (agresive cams are on the way)
